name: Racing Alpha Signals API
description: Derived horse-racing signals for GB & IRE. All values are Racing Alpha computations (derived signals) — not a raw racecards/odds feed. Free tier requires attribution ('Signals by Racing Alpha' linked to racingalpha.co.uk). Not for betting operators. Full public track record, including losses, at /performance.
